authorization: A separately governed external-artifact campaign measured a host-interface requirement for exact realization of complete prompt-supplied two-line format literals. No external code, data, outputs, evaluator logic, or evidence is imported here.
objective: Construct-certify one zero-parameter, v21-tensor-compatible LayerCake host successor that safely realizes an unambiguous explicit two-line format request from prompt literals while preserving all v21 behavior outside that narrow mode.

activation_contract.request: The UTF-8 prompt explicitly requests exactly two plain-text lines and no Markdown, then supplies the complete first and second line values in exactly two backtick spans.
activation_contract.ambiguity_policy: Fail closed to unchanged v21 neural generation when the request is incomplete, contains extra backtick spans, contains a newline or backtick inside a literal, exceeds the declared span bound, or routes to any other capability.
activation_contract.realization: Return first_literal + U+000A + second_literal after strict UTF-8 validation and maximum-token conformance.

decision_rule: Pass construct certification only if v22 is a separately signed canonical interface; tensor names and values remain exact to a matched v21 fixture; v21 manifests and malformed v22 declarations fail closed; valid explicit format prompts return only their two supplied literals on CPU and CUDA; ambiguous, extra-span, wrong-capability, over-limit, and ordinary prompts preserve v21 fallback; package identity, strict UTF-8, persistent prefill state, physical route behavior, zero learning, hostile tests, complete tests, unchanged sealed campaign verification, and independent evidence recomputation pass.
claim_boundary: Generic v22 host construct only. The narrow format path is a deterministic prompt-literal transducer and cannot replace broad neural-generation evidence. No external artifact, acquisition, English quality, information minimum, physical performance, campaign-phase recertification, or ABI-superiority claim.
